LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertAmulet.label: wasteland talisman
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertAmulet.description: A talisman assembled from old tags, wire, and scavenged tokens. Its worth comes from the story attached to it, not the scrap from which it was made.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertAntlers.label: mutant-antler trophy
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertAntlers.description: A preserved rack taken from an unusually dangerous mutant beast and carried as proof that it was brought down.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertApple.label: Zetan alloy sphere
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertApple.description: A seamless sphere of unfamiliar alloy attributed to the Zetans. It is inert, but still unnervingly cold to the touch.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertAxeHead.label: tribal axe head
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertAxeHead.description: The battered head of a tribal war axe. Its edge is ruined, leaving only the memory of whoever once carried it.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBone.label: irradiated bone fragment
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBone.description: A carefully preserved bone fragment marked by old radiation burns and generations of ritual handling.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBook.label: pre-War field manual
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBook.description: A weathered pre-War field manual whose surviving notes have been copied, argued over, and treated as guidance for generations.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBottle.label: Nuka-Cola bottle
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBottle.description: An old Nuka-Cola bottle preserved long after its contents disappeared. A faded mark or remembered owner has made it more valuable than ordinary glass.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBowl.label: wasteland offering bowl
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBowl.description: A simple bowl blackened by candles, incense, or generations of small offerings.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBracelet.label: pre-War identification bracelet
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBracelet.description: A corroded identification bracelet from a hospital, shelter, or evacuation center. The stamped name is still barely legible.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBrokenMask.label: broken raider mask
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBrokenMask.description: The shattered remains of a raider mask, preserved as a warning, a victory trophy, or a reminder of its former wearer.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBrokenSpear.label: tribal spearhead
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBrokenSpear.description: A broken tribal spearhead too damaged for combat but still bearing the marks of a remembered hunt or battle.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBucket.label: Pitt foundry crucible
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertBucket.description: A small iron crucible from the foundries of the Pitt, scorched and pitted by years of molten scrap.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertCeremonialMask.label: tribal ceremonial mask
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertCeremonialMask.description: A hand-worked mask worn during wasteland rites. Repairs and soot stains show that it passed through many keepers.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertChain.label: broken slave-chain link
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertChain.description: A heavy link cut from a slave chain. It can represent captivity, liberation, or vengeance depending on who preserves it.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertEngine.label: REPCONN guidance module
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertEngine.description: A damaged REPCONN guidance component recovered from aerospace wreckage. Its circuitry is dead, but the stamped serial plate remains.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertEngram.label: memory holodisk
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertEngram.description: A damaged holodisk believed to contain the memories or testimony of an important wastelander. Most terminals can no longer read it.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertFossil.label: mutant fossil
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertFossil.description: The mineralized remains of a strange creature whose shape does not match any ordinary pre-War animal.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertGauntlet.label: power-armor gauntlet
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertGauntlet.description: A ruined power-armor gauntlet with its servos and plating fused solid. Unit markings hint at a long-forgotten wearer.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertHorn.label: brahmin war horn
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertHorn.description: A carved brahmin horn once sounded to gather a caravan, warn a settlement, or begin a tribal charge.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertIdol.label: Children of Atom idol
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertIdol.description: A crude irradiated idol shaped by followers of Atom. Its surface has been polished by repeated ritual handling.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertImplant.label: Big MT neural implant
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertImplant.description: An inert neural implant bearing Big MT manufacturing marks. Whatever experimental purpose it served is no longer clear.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertInsectSkull.label: cazador skull
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertInsectSkull.description: The preserved head casing of an enormous cazador, kept as a trophy by someone fortunate enough to survive the encounter.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertMechanoidHead.label: combat robot head
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertMechanoidHead.description: The ruined head of a pre-War combat robot. Its optical assembly is dark, though the armored casing still bears weapon scars.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertMedallion.label: Brotherhood service medallion
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertMedallion.description: A Brotherhood service medallion whose scratched reverse records a name, unit, or campaign no living scribe can fully identify.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertMug.label: Vault-Tec commemorative mug
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertMug.description: A chipped Vault-Tec promotional mug from before the bombs, preserved as a reminder of a promised future that never arrived.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertPlate.label: Saturnite slag
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertPlate.description: A fused plate of Saturnite slag from an experimental foundry. Its strange sheen survived heat, radiation, and decades of exposure.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertPolishedRock.label: irradiated geode
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertPolishedRock.description: A polished geode whose crystals glow faintly after long exposure to radioactive groundwater.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertPyramid.label: Zetan pyramid
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertPyramid.description: A small geometric object attributed to Zetan technology. No seam, control, or recognizable power source can be found.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertRing.label: pre-War signet ring
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertRing.description: A heavy pre-War signet ring bearing the seal of a family, company, or government office now lost to history.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertScroll.label: sealed military dispatch
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertScroll.description: A rolled and sealed military dispatch preserved in a protective wrapping. Opening it would destroy what little remains of the document.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertShroud.label: wasteland burial shroud
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertShroud.description: A patched burial shroud associated with a revered leader, martyr, or unidentified victim of the wastes.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertSkull.label: irradiated human skull
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertSkull.description: A human skull discolored by radiation and carefully marked by later hands. Its identity matters more than its material value.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertStack.label: stack of holodisks
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertStack.description: A strapped stack of damaged holodisks rescued from a ruined archive. Only fragments of their records remain readable.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertStatuette.label: Vault Boy statuette
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertStatuette.description: A small Vault Boy statuette whose cheerful pose survived the destruction of the world it advertised.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertSword.label: broken officer's saber
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertSword.description: The broken remains of a ceremonial officer's saber. It cannot serve as a weapon, but its markings preserve the memory of its owner.
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertTools.label: Big MT precision tools
LanguageData.VIE_RelicInertTools.description: A set of specialized Big MT instruments built for a scientific procedure no surviving technician understands.
